name: lower-ends-empty-strings-and-lists
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): Every constrained value at lb (all zero bits); y -5 is lb: one octet 00 after length 1; z 0 is one octet 00; label of one character (count 0 in 3 bits); s1 count 0 and s2 length 0 decode to the empty string, present (ruling 13); presence 00, so neither c2 nor val; items count 0 and names length 0 decode to present, empty lists (ruling 12). 120 bits, padded with 0 zero bits to 15 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
